title: Half-Life: Blue Shift
_note: Blue Shift is a STANDALONE product with its OWN engine - bshift.exe, its own hw.dll and sw.dll, protocol 40 / build 1588. It is NOT 'hl.exe -game bshift'; the library staged it that way onto Half-Life GOTY's Sep-2001 engine (protocol 45 / build 1792) and that engine REJECTS Blue Shift's April-2001 game DLL outright - 'Game DLL version mismatch' then Host_Error. That is why this is its own tree. Installed from the retail disc in the build VM 2026-09-01; 143 files, 264,492,993 bytes. REFUTED AND NOT PROMOTED - the blocker is SecuROM, not the mounter. Retail Blue Shift 1.0 answers 'Wrong disc inserted' to this image; with no disc at all it says 'No disc inserted', so it is a disc-IDENTITY check. THREE candidate causes have now been tested and all three are dead, do not repeat any of them: (1) the volume label - a copy was relabelled to BLUESHIFT in BOTH the ISO9660 primary descriptor AND the Joliet SVD, which is the one Windows reports, the guest read BLUESHIFT and the game still refused; (2) the CD key - the owner's own key seeded into the sierra.inf leaf and into Valve\Half-Life\Settings\Key in both hives, read back to confirm, still refused; (3) A REAL MOUNTER - measured on .143 2026-09-01 with DAEMON Tools 3.47, the unmodified ISO mounted on E: as BLUESHIFT_UK with the right contents, and the game still said 'Wrong disc inserted', including after all four emulation options were turned ON (checkmarks and a changed d347bus\Cfg\khjeh blob both verified) and the image re-mounted. THE CAUSE: bshift.exe is SecuROM-wrapped - sections .cms_t/.cms_d, entry point RVA 0x000e8a6d inside .cms_t, .cms_t entropy 7.17 - and Razor 1911's own .nfo for this title says 'Protection: Securom'. That is why the dialog string is in NEITHER the tree NOR the disc (searched as ASCII and UTF-16LE): it lives in the encrypted wrapper. SecuROM 4.x authenticates by Data Position Measurement, the angular position of sectors on a pressed CD, and Blue Shift.iso is exactly 150,257 x 2048 - a plain ISO9660 dump with no raw sectors and no DPM, re-mastered in 2010. Emulation REPLAYS a protection the image must still carry; it cannot invent one. The tree stays in Files\tmp\blueshift-build\. THE ONE ROUTE LEFT, and it is untried: the disc itself carries hl1106.exe, Sierra/Valve's OFFICIAL Half-Life 1.1.0.6 update, whose engine generation matches Blue Shift's 'Protocol version 40 / Exe build 1588' - an official unwrapped hl.exe/hw.dll dropped into this tree would be the Doom 3 / Halo 1 route, with nothing cracked anywhere.
